_about: Final results of the Lying Latents project, extracted from the final-design result files by scripts/collect_final_results.py. All knockoff FDR results use the cross-validated lasso penalty; Stage 5 uses K = 50, bet cap 0.9. Superseded runs are not included.

null_coin_lasso._note: mechanism diagnostic; computed on the strong-signal design

binarised._design: strong signals, fixed lambda 0.02 (arm not run under CV)

_spec.khera: zero ablation as published; D_j = drop(random other candidate) - drop(j), comparator redrawn per input; aGRAPA, cap 0.5/B; e-BH at alpha 0.05
_spec.scored_against: tau_j > delta (the minimum-effect truth); khera_fdr_own_target against tau_j > mean tau of the other candidates
